claims: Lester Martinez defeated Immanuwel Aleem by a wide unanimous decision on March 21, 2026
The fight took place at the National Orange Show Event Center in San Bernardino, CA
Lester Martinez captured the WBC interim super middleweight title
Lester Martinez has a record of 20-0-1
Immanuwel Aleem has a record of 22-4-3
Lester Martinez became the first-ever world boxing titleholder from Guatemala
The judges scored the fight 118-110, 119-109, and 120-108
The fight was on ProBox TV
Lester Martinez is trained by Brian "BoMac" McIntyre
